about_the_game:
Jump, bounce, and roll through jobs to unite Odd’s family in their new home. Unlock quirky relatives, grab collectibles, and explore differently themed worlds in this wholesome platforming adventure. 

Core Gameplay:

  • Play as Odd. He's a little guy with a big family.

  • Complete jobs, collect coins, and unlock rooms in your house for new relatives to move in. Each unlocked relative opens access to new levels with unique themes and objectives. Plant flowers, find lost cats, cook hotdogs, and collect worms to support your family. 

  • Turn each relatives' vacant room into a playful space through optional collectibles. 

  • Snappy character controls turn obstacles and hazards into playgrounds.

  • Cute, cartoony 3D visuals with classic side scrolling platformer gameplay. 

Wholesome Story:

  • Endearing and accessible story about a family settling into their new home. Bite-sized dialogue offers both humor and reflection on familial responsibility.

  • Enjoy the charm of an indie title lightheartedly conveying deeper themes inspired by the solo developer’s own family experiences.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 13/14 (Ventura/Sonoma) or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 / M2 (or intel Core i7 2018+)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1/M2 GPU

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Ryzen 3 (or equivalent)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD integrated graphics or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
